name: cold_chain
question: Is the cold storage safe, and if temperature rose, why? (Capstone C4 cold side)

sensors.role: cold-store temperature (5 degC / 4 h HACCP rule)

reasoning_prompt: Apply the four-quadrant diagnosis: temperature rising with door open is carelessness (close the door); rising with door closed and compressor current at zero is a compressor or power fault (critical, move the food); rising with door closed and compressor running is load or refrigerant trouble. Produce the HACCP event log for the window: every excursion above 5 degC with duration, peak, attributed cause, and the action taken or required.
